steps.what: Perform inspections of forests or forest nurseries through direct observation and assessment

tasks.design: Retain field inspection and interpretation with the forester, recording working observations in {DOCS}. Broad land-cover data does not replace checking actual forest or nursery conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site condition requires direct observation and contextual interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing field methods and notes support inspections.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete visibility and distinguishing normal variation from a developing problem.
tasks.human_edge: The forester investigates unexpected conditions and asks for additional evidence.

reach.learn: Preserve location, timing and observation uncertainty

evidence.claim: Copernicus supplies land-cover, land-use and water data; that supports context rather than replacement of forest inspections.

assumptions: The baseline is field inspection, not a separate inspection report-writing task.
The forester produces observations within s1 with all travel, capture and assessment time retained.
Existing DOCS and field methods precede a new application.
No new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which inspection findings cannot be inferred from the available remote data?

already_counted.description: Direct observation, capture and field assessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100; gross and net saving zero. Remote data availability does not establish inspection labour reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor forestry contract and regulatory adherence

steps.what: Capture contract obligations and verify evidence of forestry activity results
Display contract evidence gaps and recorded review dates for compliance monitoring
Assess contract compliance and forestry results and resolve concerns with responsible parties

tasks.design: Configure obligation and evidence views in {CLM}, linking original records in {DOCS}. The forester determines applicability and actual adherence; a reference being present never means the requirement is satisfied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly assembling obligation and evidence-reference lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Native contract registers can display recorded review dates and missing links.
tasks.still_hard: Whether activities actually meet a requirement and whether evidence is trustworthy.
tasks.human_edge: The forester interprets requirements and challenges unsupported claims.

reach.learn: Separate document presence from substantive adherence

evidence.claim: A configured contract-evidence view is a proposed E1 design; the digest establishes no measured forestry compliance dashboard deployment.

assumptions: Only repetitive list assembly changes; field inspection and legal or contractual interpretation retain full time elsewhere or in s3.

In s1 the forester produces obligation identifier, source clause, applicability decision, review date and evidence reference; 40 hours include source selection, capture and correction. Missing or disputed applicability requires manual review in s3.
Native CLM registers precede custom dashboards or models.
Responsible parties provide explanations during s3 discussions; no extra structured contractor reporting contract is imposed.
research_questions: Can a native view reproduce a checked obligation sample while exposing missing evidence without labeling it compliant?

already_counted.description: Requirement capture, evidence verification and adherence judgment

incremental.description: Maintain obligation versions and audit reference integrity
Maintain access controls and view mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80 gives 20 gross less 7 focal upkeep =13 central net. Report 0-3 until list assembly is timed; source repair or existing registers can erase the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Supervise forestry activities through work observation, direct guidance and worker feedback

tasks.design: Keep live work supervision and coaching with the forester, using existing plans in {DOCS}. A dashboard does not substitute for observing the work and resolving local coordination concerns.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction depends on the actual workers, site and evolving conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing plans and direct communication support supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing when work conditions require a changed instruction.
tasks.human_edge: The forester hears concerns and adapts direction to what is happening on site.

reach.learn: Identify unclear directions and communicate observed constraints

evidence.claim: Manual forestry supervision is an E1 proposal; the digest establishes no replacement of live work direction.

assumptions: The task is supervision rather than separate schedule preparation or contract reporting.
The forester observes work and gathers worker feedback within s1 with all time retained.
Existing DOCS and communication precede software.
No new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which recurring coordination issues need clearer work instructions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving. Scheduling and reporting components are not invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise owners and organizations on forestry issues

steps.what: Provide forestry advice and recommendations after clarifying site evidence and client objectives

tasks.design: Retain contextual forestry advice and discussion with the forester, using {DOCS} for evidence and recommendations. No repeatable public FAQ or separate proposal-writing baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on site evidence, competing objectives and the recipient's circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing sources and consultation support qualified recommendations.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing conservation, economic and practical constraints under uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: The forester explains trade-offs and identifies where more evidence is needed.

reach.learn: Communicate uncertainty and competing management objectives

evidence.claim: Manual site-specific forestry consultation is an E1 design; no measured advisory replacement is supplied.

assumptions: The task is case-specific consultation, not a routine reference desk or separate report-writing operation.
The forester elicits objectives and checks evidence within s1 with all time retained; no assumed structured suitability or recommendation flag is provided.
Existing DOCS sources precede an advice assistant.
No new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Are recurring factual questions separable from site-specific recommendation discussions?

already_counted.description: Clarify objectives, assess evidence and explain recommendations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100; gross and net saving zero. No generic drafting or FAQ stage is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Direct forest stewardship supported by traceable evidence
reach: Coordinate field observations with forest technicians
Learn obligation-evidence discipline from compliance specialists
role.ambitious_version: A forester who reduces repeated evidence-list assembly while retaining field judgment, crew leadership and contextual advice
